manifests.crates/client-play/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "client-play"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[features]
# Playable by default: a plain `cargo build -p client-play` (or a later
# workspace build) still has `--window`. Headless is the same binary with
# the flag omitted. `--no-default-features` keeps the old headless-only
# compile. RSA is still baked via `tools/redeploy.sh`.
default = ["window", "audio"]
audio = ["client/audio"]
window = ["client/window"]

[dependencies]
client = { path = "../client" }
manifests.crates/client/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "client"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[features]
default = []
window = ["dep:winit", "dep:softbuffer"]
# Windows test/fixture workers may own a window loop; never enabled by product frontends.
headed-fixture = ["window"]
audio = ["dep:rustysynth", "dep:cpal"]
render-diagnostics = []
# Failure injection for independent-process snapshot publication tests only.
# Product frontends never enable this feature.
snapshot-test-hooks = []
# Host transport regressions only; never enabled by product frontends.
test-support = []

[dependencies]
bzip2 = "0.4"
bytemuck = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
cpal = { version = "0.18", optional = true }
flate2 = "1"
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false, features = ["jpeg"] }
num-bigint = "0.4"
pollster = "0.4"
rustysynth = { version = "1.3", optional = true }
sha2 = "0.10"
native-tls = "0.2"
tungstenite = { version = "0.24", features = ["native-tls"] }
softbuffer = { version = "0.4", optional = true }
wgpu = "29"
winit = { version = "0.30", optional = true }

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json = "=1.0.140"

[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]
windows-sys = { version = "0.59", features = [
    "Win32_Foundation",
    "Win32_Networking_WinSock",
    "Win32_Storage_FileSystem",
    "Win32_System_Threading",
] }
